# South Banks Towns
> A pre-construction waterfront townhome community by Deco Homes and Opus Homes at 1110 Lakeshore
> Road East, Mississauga, within the 177-acre Lakeview Village master plan.

## Key Facts
- Builders: Deco Homes & Opus Homes
- Location: 1110 Lakeshore Road East, Mississauga, ON — Lakeview Village
- Home types: 120+ three-storey freehold coastal townhomes
- Starting price (official site): from $549,990
- Launch: coming this fall (Fall 2026) — Completion: 2028
- Sales gallery: coming soon
- Last updated: 2026-09-10

## Source
Independent information resource. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Deco Homes or Opus Homes.
Figures are researched snapshots — confirm current details before purchasing.
